question: U10: the paragraph list phone rows after each pick. One Text with CAP-U10WORDS one-, two- and four-line words, each from a fresh Text, picks 0 to 5 in order; after each pick the panel closes and the phone view reads the section rows and the block areas. Runs A and B. Predictions pushed first (CAP-U10PHONEROWS-PREDICT.json). Second run: the first stopped at W4 pick 5 (layout 5 covered); the frame now goes to the top before each reopen.
steps: Paragraph words for a probe, long enough to wrap onto a second line in a block ten columns wide.

Paragraph words for a probe, long enough to fill about four lines in a block ten columns wide. The block holds plain words and nothing else, so its height comes from the words alone. A layout gives it a span, and the span may follow how tall the words stand at the new width.
